LOOK CLOSER

Small details. Real failures.

⌘
01

A capital letter changes the result.

GLM and MiniMax used East Bohemia. The database stores east Bohemia. Both returned zero accounts for Q198.

02

The right rows, the wrong field.

MiniMax found the 14 households in Q212, but returned district IDs where the reference expects district names.

MEASURE THE ANSWER

Transparent by design.

This is an independent pilot on six selected questions, not an official BIRD leaderboard or a representative measure of overall model quality.

01 / INPUT

A shared starting point

Questions 198, 200, 210, 212, 315, and 328, with schema descriptions and supplied evidence. Four questions use the financial database; two use student_club.

02 / EXECUTION

Run the submitted SQL

Submitted queries and reference queries run against the same read-only SQLite snapshots, with a 30-second query timeout. Syntax errors and timeouts count as failures.

03 / COMPARISON

Check the actual outputs

Compare exact values by column position, preserving duplicate rows. Check row order for Q212 and Q328. Column aliases do not affect the score. No numeric tolerance is applied.

Scope, provenance, and limitations +

Model names and usage are recorded from user-supplied OpenCode screenshots. SQL was submitted by the user and executed locally; model versions and generation settings were not independently verified. The MiniMax screenshot reports two assistant messages; the others report one. Only the supplied final SQL is scored. Output-format compliance is not scored.

The question set includes one moderate and five challenging tasks. Public benchmark tasks may have appeared in model training. Matching one database instance is evidence of correctness, not proof of equivalence on all possible data. “Free” is part of the supplied model labels, not a general pricing claim.

Dataset: BIRD Mini-Dev, corrected October 2026 annotations with the original SQLite dev databases. Dataset and reference SQL attribution: Li et al., Can LLM Already Serve as A Database Interface? (2023), CC BY-SA 4.0. This pilot is not affiliated with the BIRD project or the model providers.
